# Insulation UK

> UK online retailer specializing in thermal and acoustic insulation products including PIR, EPS, XPS, and mineral wool boards for trade and DIY customers.

Insulation UK offers a comprehensive range of insulation materials from leading brands like Celotex, Kingspan, Jablite, and Rockwool. The site serves both professional contractors and DIY customers with product catalogs, installation guides, and specialized services like CNC cutting.

## Key Topics

- PIR insulation boards
- EPS (Expanded Polystyrene)
- XPS insulation
- Floor insulation
- Thermal insulation
- Acoustic insulation
- Mineral wool
- Celotex
- Kingspan
- Jablite
- Rockwool
- Building regulations
- Bespoke cutting service
- Bulk pricing
- UK delivery

## Core Product Collections

- [Shop Insulation Online | PIR, Loft, Wall & Roof | Trade & DIY | UK – Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk): Homepage showcasing Insulation UK's product range including PIR, loft, wall and roof insulation from major brands.
- [PIR Insulation Boards | PIR Insulation | Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/pir-insulation): Comprehensive PIR insulation board catalog from Celotex, Kingspan, Recticel, Unilin and Ecotherm.
- [Polystyrene Insulation Boards | EPS & XPS | Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/polystyrene-insulation): Broad polystyrene insulation catalog including EPS and XPS boards from 13mm to 75mm+ thickness.
- [EPS Floor Insulation – Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/eps-insulation): EPS floor insulation collection featuring Jablite Jabfloor boards for all floor construction types.
- [XPS Insulation UK | Moisture Resistant & High Strength | Fast Delivery](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/xps-insulation): Premium XPS insulation from Kingspan GreenGuard and Ravatherm with moisture resistance for floors and basements.

## Floor Insulation Solutions

- [Floor Insulation UK | PIR, EPS, XPS & Mineral Wool | Low Prices](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/floor-insulation): Product catalog for floor insulation including PIR, EPS, XPS and mineral wool from Celotex, Kingspan and Jablite.
- [Concrete Floor Insulation – Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/concrete-floor-insulation): Specialized product collection for concrete slab insulation using Celotex PIR boards and related materials.
- [Suspended Floor Insulation | Between Joist PIR & Mineral Wool | UK – Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/suspended-floor-insulation): Product collection for suspended timber floor insulation with PIR boards and Rockwool mineral wool slabs.
- [Phenolic Floor Insulation – Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/phenolic-floor-insulation): Premium phenolic insulation from Kingspan Kooltherm K103 for high-performance floor applications.

## Thickness-Specific Polystyrene Boards

- [25mm Polystyrene Insulation Boards | Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/25mm-polystyrene-insulation): 25mm EPS polystyrene boards from Jablite including Jabfloor range with various thermal ratings.
- [50mm Polystyrene Insulation Boards | Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/50mm-polystyrene-insulation): 50mm EPS and XPS polystyrene boards from Jablite, SPI, Kingspan and Ravatherm for floor insulation.
- [75mm Polystyrene Insulation Boards | Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/75mm-polystyrene-insulation): 75mm polystyrene boards from Jablite and Ravatherm offering EPS and XPS insulation options.
- [100mm Polystyrene Insulation Boards | Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/100mm-polystyrene-insulation): 100mm polystyrene boards from Jablite, Ravatherm and Kingspan in EPS and XPS formats.

## Specialized Insulation Types

- [Acoustic Insulation UK | Soundproofing Wool | Rockwool, Knauf & Isover](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/acoustic-insulation): Acoustic insulation products from Rockwool, Knauf and Isover for soundproofing floors, walls and partitions.
- [Fire Resistant Insulation | Rockwool, Knauf & More | Fast UK Delivery – Insulation UK](https://www.insulationuk.co.uk/collections/fire-resistant-insulation): Fire-resistant A1 rated insulation slabs and rolls from Rockwool, Knauf and Superglass.
